text:
tess: Heads-up: Mendota Health wants to POC a custom finetuned Llama-3-14B variant. They sent safetensors + tokenizer.zip. Main asks: compat with our runtime, 32k context/KV-cache support, recommended quant profile for cost targets, 2-week POC pricing at ~150-200 rps, and KMS/VPC needs. Need response by tomorrow EOD. @omar @jin

omar: Do we have the artifact link? Need model_type, config.json, tokenizer.json, and any special added tokens. If it's HF-style safetensors we can run the compat job quickly. Example minimal config we expect as text: {"model_type":"causal","context_length":32768}.

jin: For KV-cache: warmup matters. If traffic is chat-like with long recency, we should bench with 32k sequences and kv cache enabled. Hosted might do short bursts but for stable p99 <200ms at 200rps we should recommend Dedicated. Can run a perf sweep on gpus A10G/H100.

rachael: Security flags: do they require BYOK/HSM? If yes, we need Private/Dedicated with KMS integration. Also ask for SOC2 reqs, data residency, retention, and whether model data is PHI. Qs for client: do they want logs forwarded? Any egress restrictions?

infra-bot: Compat scan queued -> mendota-3412345678-compat at 3412345725.

omar: I'll kick off llm-compat-runner. ETA: results in ~6-10 hours if artifact is clean. I'll check op requirements (custom ops), dtype/tensor layout, and tokenizer mapping.

jin: Quick quant guidance: int8/trimmed int8 tends to be a good sweet spot for throughput/cost with small quality drop. int4 can be aggressive; recommend trying int8 first then int4 A/B. We'll do an automated quality delta test vs fp16 on a small prompt set.

rachael: Pricing estimate (placeholder): Hosted burst POC ~ $2kor 2 weeks (depends on tokens). Dedicated proration (single A10G-like pool) ~ $6kor 2 weeks; H100 class ~ $14k. If BYOK/HSM + VPC peering required add integration time and engineering review. I'll draft a short quote by EOD.

tess: Artifact posted: https://files.redwood.com/mendota/model-v1.safetensors + tokenizer.zip. Sending client security questionnaire now.

omar: Compat report: no custom ops, tokenizer OK, model_type=causal, context_length=32768. Minor vocab size mismatch noted but not blocking. Perf bench scheduled.

infra-bot: Perf job started -> mendota-perf-3412345678 on A10G at 3412345775.

jin: After perf: I'll attach latency/throughput matrix and recommendations for batching/kv cache sizing. Also will produce a quick quant profile (int8 vs int4) with cost delta.

rachael: Security next steps: send BYOK flow doc if they request HSM, request SOC2 certs, and confirm PHI handling. If they need private deployment, legal will need to review the contract addendum which adds 3-5 business days.

omar: Compat results posted: ops OK, model loads, context respected. Will produce bench logs by tomorrow MORNING.

tess: Thanks team 44d I'll update Mendota with recommended path: start compat + hosted perf for quick validation, then spin Dedicated if p99 needs tightening or BYOK requested.

sales-bot: Reminder: create POC quote draft in SFDC and link to ticket #POC-7891.

jin: Action items: omar -> post perf logs and compat artifacts; rachael -> draft quote + security checklist; tess -> update customer + confirm BYOK need.

tess: Looping in done, will update when client confirms BYOK or proceeds with hosted trial. Thanks.
